sloka: अथवा पुत्रशोकेन अहत्वा रामलक्ष्मणौ।विधमिष्यति मां रौद्रो राक्षसः पापनिश्चयः ।। ६.९३.५३ ।।
transliteration: athavā putraśokena ahatvā rāmalakṣmaṇau।vidhamiṣyati māṁ raudro rākṣasaḥ pāpaniścayaḥ ।। 6.93.53 ।।

translations.english: Many Rakshasas rejoiced, calling out their loved ones loudly, making huge noise, were heard.
